name_zh: 莫布图/扎伊尔/刚果河：大人制与河流霸权
name_en: Mobutu/Zaire/Congo River: Big Man Rule & River Hegemony
description_zh: 蒙博托·塞塞·塞科 (1930-1997) 1965-1997 统治扎伊尔 (今刚果金) 32 年，典型"大人制" (Big Man) 模式。核心统治逻辑：个人崇拜/蒙博图主义/独裁/贪腐/克宾沙/刚果河控制/矿产掠夺/外交平衡(西方/中苏/非洲)→1990s 冷战结束/内战/卢旺达种族灭绝溢出/1997 卡比拉推翻/流亡摩洛哥病逝。体现 M189 大人制/河流霸权——以"个人崇拜+河流控制+矿产掠夺+外交摇摆"四位一体，在资源诅咒/冷战/地理碎片化中实现个人极权统治。
description_en: Mobutu Sese Seko (1930-1997) ruled Zaire (now DRC) 1965-1997 for 32 years, archetypal 'Big Man' rule. Core governance logic: personality cult/Mobutuism/dictatorship/corruption/Gbadolite/Congo River control/mineral plunder/diplomatic balancing (West/China-USSR/Africa) -> 1990s Cold War end/civil war/Rwandan genocide spillover/1997 Kabila overthrows/exile Morocco death. Exemplifies M189 Big Man Rule & River Hegemony—quaternity of 'personality cult + river control + mineral plunder + diplomatic oscillation' achieving personal absolute rule amid resource curse/Cold War/geographic fragmentation.
reason_zh: 蒙博图非单纯独裁者，而是"大人制+河流霸权+资源掠夺"三位一体极权模式。刚果河为其命脉/军队/经济/外交核心资产；克宾沙宫殿象征个人权力巅峰；外交在美/苏/中/法/非洲间极限摇摆。M189 区隔于 M171 资源民族主义(伊拉克)、M170 威权稳定(白俄罗斯)、M190 矿区武装(卡比拉)，核心在于"个人崇拜即意识形态+河流控制即地缘命脉+矿产掠夺即经济基础"的非洲大人制极限范式。
reason_en: Mobutu not mere dictator but 'Big Man rule + river hegemony + resource plunder' trinity totalitarian model. Congo River as lifeline/military/economy/diplomacy core asset; Gbadolite palace symbolizes personal power apex; diplomacy extreme oscillation between US/USSR/China/France/Africa. M189 distinct from M171 Resource Nationalist (Iraq), M170 Authoritarian Stability (Belarus), M190 Mining Zone Warlord (Kabila), core: 'personality cult as ideology + river control as geostrategic lifeline + mineral plunder as economic base' African Big Man extreme paradigm.
steps_zh: 个人崇拜意识形态化：蒙博图主义/真理之光/全民导师/头像无处不在/媒体垄断/教育灌输，个人即国家
刚果河绝对控制：河流即领土/军队/经济/外交，水运/水电/渔业/边界/战略纵深，控河即控国
矿产掠夺与克宾沙经济：铜/钴/钻石/钽/黄金/个人敛财/瑞士账户/克宾沙宫殿/跑道/野生动物园，国家财富私有化
外交极限摇摆：美/苏/中/法/比/南非/利比亚/安哥拉/卢旺达，冷战筹码/反共盾牌/法语非洲领袖/不结盟运动
崩塌与遗产：1990s 冷战结束/内战/卢旺达溢出/1996-97 第一次/第二次刚果战争/1997 卡比拉推翻/流亡摩洛哥病逝/国家碎片化/资源诅咒加深
steps_en: Personality cult ideologization: Mobutuism/Light of Truth/National Guide/portraits everywhere/media monopoly/education indoctrination, individual = state
Congo River absolute control: river as territory/military/economy/diplomacy, transport/hydro/fisheries/border/strategic depth, control river = control country
Mineral plunder & Gbadolite economy: copper/cobalt/diamonds/coltan/gold/personal enrichment/Swiss accounts/Gbadolite palace/runway/wildlife park, state wealth privatized
Diplomatic extreme oscillation: US/USSR/China/France/Belgium/South Africa/Libya/Angola/Rwanda, Cold War chip/anti-communist shield/Francophone Africa leader/Non-Aligned Movement
Collapse & legacy: 1990s Cold War end/civil war/Rwandan spillover/1996-97 First/Second Congo Wars/1997 Kabila overthrows/exile Morocco death/state fragmentation/resource curse deepened
expected_zh: 以"个人崇拜+河流控制+矿产掠夺+外交摇摆"四位一体，在资源诅咒/冷战/地理碎片化中实现个人极权统治 32 年，留下国家碎片化/资源诅咒加深/刚果战争遗毒的警世遗产。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'personality cult + river control + mineral plunder + diplomatic oscillation' achieves 32-year personal absolute rule amid resource curse/Cold War/geographic fragmentation, leaving legacy of state fragmentation/resource curse deepening/Congo Wars cautionary tale.
case_zh: 1965 政变上台/1971 改国名扎伊尔/1973 锎赞比亚铜业/1977 克宾沙建成/1990s 冷战结束/1996-97 刚果战争/1997 卡比拉入金夏沙/摩洛哥病逝/刚果战争 500 万+ 死亡/资源诅咒延续，大人制极限警世。
case_en: 1965 coup power/1971 renamed Zaire/1973 nationalized Zambian copper/1977 Gbadolite completed/1990s Cold War end/1996-97 Congo Wars/1997 Kabila enters Kinshasa/Morocco death/Congo Wars 5M+ deaths/resource curse continues, Big Man extreme cautionary tale.
